summary: Harden ui_server.py against unhandled exceptions and add supervisor auto-restart
details: A single FastAPI route raising an unhandled exception currently kills the worker process and there's no supervisor restart, so the entire UI goes dark until ZO_RESTART_TS is manually bumped. This was observed at 2026-05-09T16:34Z when /admin-threats returned 521 and the root URL stayed down for >10 minutes. Single point of failure with manual recovery is unacceptable for a trust-intelligence surface that other systems depend on. Note: the supervisord conf change is a follow-up if the builder can't touch files outside ui_server.py; the middleware and /healthz changes are in-scope for ui_server.py itself. The admin-route directives (677fa0e2, etc.) should be applied alongside this so the underlying bugs get fixed AND the server can survive future ones — order doesn't matter because the middleware catches whatever the broken handlers raise.
suggested_fix:
Three changes, all in ui_server.py (or its supervisord conf — flag as a follow-up if outside scope):

1. Global exception middleware. Add a FastAPI middleware that catches any unhandled exception, logs the traceback to the existing log path, and returns a clean JSON 500 with {"error":"internal","ray_id":<request_id>}. Pattern:

    @app.exception_handler(Exception)
    async def unhandled(request, exc):
        logger.exception("unhandled at %s", request.url.path)
        return JSONResponse(status_code=500, content={"error":"internal"})

2. /healthz endpoint returning 200 with {"status":"ok","ts":<utc>} so a watchdog (or Cloudflare health check) can detect a dead worker.

3. Supervisord autorestart. In the supervisord config that owns ui_server.py (likely /etc/supervisor/conf.d/zo_sentinel.conf or similar — recon noted ~40 supervisord-managed daemons), set autorestart=true, startsecs=5, startretries=3, and redirect_stderr=true. If autorestart isn't usable (e.g., wrong supervisor variant), substitute with a systemd Restart=on-failure unit or a tiny shell loop wrapper.
